The '''2009 FA Community Shield''' (also known as '''The FA Community Shield sponsored by [[McDonald's]]''' for sponsorship reasons) was the 87th [[FA Community Shield]], an annual [[association football|football]] match contested by the winners of the previous season's [[Premier League]] and [[FA Cup]] competitions. The match was contested at [[Wembley Stadium]], [[London]], on 9 August 2009,<ref>{{cite news |title=Shield date confirmed |url=http://www.thefa.com/TheFACup/FACompetitions/TheFACommunityShield/NewsAndFeatures/2009/Shield_date_confirmed.aspx |work=TheFA.com |publisher=The Football Association |date=2 March 2009 |access-date=15 May 2009 }}</ref> and contested by [[2008–09 Premier League]] champions [[Manchester United F.C.|Manchester United]], and [[Chelsea F.C.|Chelsea]] as the winners of the [[2008–09 FA Cup]], a repeat of the [[2007 FA Community Shield|2007 match]]. The game ended in a 2–2 draw – the goals coming from [[Nani (footballer)|Nani]] and [[Wayne Rooney]] for Manchester United, and from [[Ricardo Carvalho]] and [[Frank Lampard]] for Chelsea – with Chelsea winning 4–1 on [[Penalty shootout (association football)|penalties]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Chelsea 2 – 2 Man Utd |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/8190061.stm |website=BBC Sport |date=9 August 2009 |access-date=10 August 2009 }}</ref>

This was also the first time since 1998 that Chelsea had won a professional match on penalties; The last instance was a [[Football League Cup|League Cup]] quarter-final against [[Ipswich Town F.C.|Ipswich Town]].{{citation needed|date=February 2012}}
